purpose: Restore the previously discussed 10% practical-benefit rule and disclose status of 20% forecast-error checking.
aggregation: Compute percentage per paired repeat, then take median of five. Also retain min/max and counts.
categories: p >= 10: sorted at least 10% faster; -10 < p < 10: near tie; p <= -10: sorted at least 10% slower.
important: Positive net saving and at least 10% saving are different thresholds. Earlier summary omitted the near-tie label.

forecast_review.status: Supplementary retrospective audit using only pre-formal frozen predictor inputs; not a completed preregistered single-forecast validation.
forecast_review.evaluation: Both pilot sources evaluated separately, all measured N retained; medians and all-repeat maximum errors reported. No fitted coefficients or selection by formal results.
